_comment: The integrity fixture (claim B5). This manifest is signed like every other, and its signature is VALID -- what is wrong is the digest, which does not match guest-kotlin.js. It models a script swapped at the origin after the manifest was signed, which is the one attack a sidecar signature cannot see on its own. `signWebSidecars` leaves this file's digest alone by name; every other manifest gets the real one stamped in.
